review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, target-values.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolution and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (13 byte windows and the three vtables whose slots 0/1 are lea eax,[ecx+N]; ret, pinned in the acceptance test): the BEEPER_SEEKER callback 0x441780 stores virtual slot 0 and slot 1 of the found beeper object into projectile +0x70/+0x74; slot 0 is a pointer to a 3-float position (the beeper search 0x4b8b50 dereferences it as one); the steering routine 0x5af960 calls 0x538ca0(&proj+0x48, [proj+0x70]) which computes normalize(*[+0x70] - proj position), and, with [+0x74] non-zero, the solver 0x53e56d with [+0x70] and [+0x74] as target position and second vector (read as target velocity). STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of target-values.json. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
